framework.name: CompTIA SecAI+
framework.description: AI-security certification track: AI as attack target and AI as weapon.

threats.title: Prompt Injection (exam objective)
threats.description: Direct and indirect prompt injection as an AI-as-target attack vector, covering chat and RAG surfaces.
threats.attack_vector: Malicious instructions in chat input or in retrieved/ingested documents.

threats.title: Data Poisoning (exam objective)
threats.description: Poisoning training data or an MLOps pipeline to manipulate future model behavior.
threats.attack_vector: Compromised data vendor or CI/CD pipeline for model training.

threats.title: Model Theft (exam objective)
threats.description: Extracting or cloning proprietary model weights/IP via systematic API querying.
threats.attack_vector: High-volume API querying to reconstruct model behavior.

threats.title: Excessive Agency (exam objective)
threats.description: Agentic AI systems granted more permission than needed via plugin/tool integration.
threats.attack_vector: Plugin or tool-integration vulnerability exploited to exceed intended scope.

threats.title: Membership Inference / Model Inversion
threats.description: Confidence-score-based privacy attacks that reveal whether specific data was used in training, or reconstruct it.
threats.attack_vector: Repeated queries analyzing confidence scores to infer training set membership.

threats.title: AI-Mutating Malware (AI as weapon)
threats.description: Polymorphic malware that uses an LLM to rewrite its own signature and evade detection.
threats.attack_vector: Attacker uses an LLM to generate signature variants faster than defenses can update.

threats.title: AI-Powered Phishing and Deepfakes (AI as weapon)
threats.description: Mass-personalized phishing with no language tells, and deepfake voice/video for vishing or biometric bypass.
threats.attack_vector: LLM-generated personalized lures; synthetic voice/video impersonating an executive.

threats.title: Adversarial Examples (exam objective)
threats.description: Imperceptible input noise crafted to fool a classifier into a wrong decision.
threats.attack_vector: Perturbed input that a human perceives as unchanged but flips model output.
